key_points: Use fast exponentiation (binary exponentiation) to compute xⁿ in O(log n) multiplications.

Iteratively square the base and multiply result when the current bit of n is 1.

key_points: Count frequencies with a hash map, then extract the k most frequent using a min‑heap of size k.
Push each (frequency, element) onto the heap; if heap size exceeds k, pop the smallest frequency.
Time complexity: O(n log k) where n is array length; Space complexity: O(n) for the map plus O(k) for the heap.
Alternative bucket sort achieves O(n) time when element range is limited.

records.text: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
key_points: Track the minimum price seen so far and the maximum profit achievable at each step.
Update minPrice = min(minPrice, price[i]) and maxProfit = max(maxProfit, price[i] - minPrice).
Time complexity: O(n) single pass; Space complexity: O(1).
Works for both increasing, decreasing, and fluctuating price sequences.
Edge cases: empty or single‑day array (profit 0), all prices decreasing (profit 0).

key_points: Dynamic programming: dp[i] = true if s[0:i] can be segmented; dp[0] = true.
For each position i, check all j < i where dp[j] is true and s[j:i] is in the word dictionary (hash set).
Time complexity: O(n² * m) worst case, where n is string length and m is average word length; can be reduced with Trie to O(n * L).
Space complexity: O(n) for dp array plus O(dict) for the word set.
Edge cases: empty string, dictionary containing empty string, overlapping words, very long string with no segmentation.

key_points: DP where dp[i] = number of ways to decode the prefix of length i.
Transition: if s[i‑1] != '0' add dp[i‑1]; if two‑digit number formed by s[i‑2:i] is between 10 and 26, add dp[i‑2].
Initialize dp[0] = 1, dp[1] based on first character.
Time complexity: O(n); Space complexity: O(n) or O(1) by keeping only two previous values.
Edge cases: leading zeros, consecutive zeros, single‑digit string, very large input (use modulo if required).

key_points: Expand Around Center: for each index treat it as a center of odd and even length palindrome and expand while characters match.

key_points: Combine a doubly linked list with a hash map: map keys to list nodes for O(1) get/put.

records.text: Dot Product of Two Sparse Vectors
key_points: Represent each sparse vector as a hash map of index → value.
Iterate over the smaller map, multiply matching indices from the other map, and accumulate the sum.
Time complexity: O(min(n₁, n₂)) where n₁, n₂ are numbers of non‑zero entries; Space complexity: O(1) beyond input storage.
If vectors are stored as sorted lists of (index, value), use two‑pointer merge for O(n₁ + n₂).
Edge cases: one or both vectors empty, all zeros, large indices causing overflow.

records.text: Maximize Unique Characters from Word List. Category: AI-Enabled Round. Description: Staged build + optimization (greedy -> trie switch forced by tests).
key_points: Use a greedy selection of words that add the most new characters, then switch to a Trie to efficiently track character coverage and avoid overlap.
